name: Ustava Republike Slovenije in Zakon o volitvah v državni zbor

scope.when_absent: no scope note is recorded in this corpus (transitional provisions are kept as text, not parsed); not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: laws, regulations and general acts cannot have retroactive effect; only a law may provide that some of its provisions have retroactive effect, where the public interest requires it and acquired rights are not infringed
default_reach.authority: Ustava Republike Slovenije, 155. člen (Uradni list RS, št. 33/91-I)
